identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][claims] Make released bound claims safely reacquirable

values.task_boundary: Add only the typed reacquisition operation, dormant doctor classification, and focused proof required by #5727.
deliverables: dormant-record doctor classification and next action
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A resumable nonterminal record with claim null is valid dormant state.
AC-2: Typed compare-and-swap reacquisition validates issue, generation, digest, actor, purpose, branch, worktree, lease timestamps, and protected paths.
AC-3: Reacquisition rejects overlap with other live protected-path claims.
AC-4: Released and expired claims are reacquired without lifecycle rewind or audit loss.
AC-5: Read-only inspection does not require an active claim while mutations still do.
AC-6: Focused tests cover release, expiry, overlap, stale identity, invalid binding, and append-only audit.
AC-7: Prepared issue #5354 returns to doctor PASS through the typed operation.
non_goals: receipt or closeout gating for claims
